Second pre-release of 1.3, based on feedback to beta1.

## Changed

- **Cover moved into the Metadata area.** It sits right of the form, like in Calibre's metadata editor, with *From file*, *Look up*, *Export* and *Discard new* below it (right-click for all actions). *All without cover* is in the toolbar. The separate Covers area is gone; its filters (no cover, small cover) are in the Metadata list.
- **All fields have the same width.** When Calibre or KOReader have a different value, it appears below the field as *← Calibre: …* — click the arrow to take it over.
- **Own fields instead of just a subtitle.** *Settings > Books > Metadata*: add any Calibre column (lookup name like `#subtitle`, plus a label), reorder or remove them, or take all columns found in `metadata.calibre`. Number, yes/no and date columns are checked.
- **Calibre comparison can be switched off** (*Settings > Books > Calibre*). The Calibre buttons disappear, `metadata.calibre` is ignored.
- **Series numbers with a comma** (1,5) are accepted and stored as 1.5, like Calibre does.

Settings from beta1: a subtitle field you switched on becomes an own field automatically.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_1.3-beta2.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
